payload.claim: The Out of scope section says b-edcab7's three stale sentences 'are in files this spec forbids,' but per docs/backlog/b-edcab7-...md the three sentences live in saffron/reconcile.py:1-4, saffron/ledger.py's set_task_package docstring, and saffron/cell/session.py:1297. Only saffron/cell/session.py is actually covered by the forbidden list (via saffron/cell/**); saffron/reconcile.py and saffron/ledger.py appear in neither forbidden nor touches, so they are out of scope by omission rather than by an explicit forbid. This is inconsequential: the touches list already acts as the effective allowlist and the problem statement never directs any edit to reconcile.py or ledger.py, so no cell behavior is affected.
